pathSyntax: dot-separated segments; a numeric segment indexes an array; the leaf value is compared with deep JSON equality
factSelector: a fact selects the chain event by spanId when present; otherwise by kind+nodeKey+status (S5 convention). Derived '#trace.*' facts need no selector.
derivedPathSyntax: paths starting with '#trace.' are computed over the whole source before fact lookup: spanCount, kindCount, fetchCount, backendSpanCount, hasFrontend, hasBackend, serviceSpanCount, valuesSpanCount, valueCount, l2FlagSpanCount, noDebugFlagSpanCount (spans whose flags contain NO_DEBUG_INFO), noDebugStatusSpanCount, reasonSpanCount (spans carrying a reason), serviceValuesAbsent, serviceSourceLineNullOrAbsent, noAsyncFlag, noVariableNameGuess, graphNodeKeyCount
note: S6b no-debug fixture ONLY. This file is deterministic contract shape, NOT runtime evidence: the real NOT_COLLECTED_NO_DEBUG_INFO event, its verbatim reason, the missing values and the absent line number must come from the antrun debug=false NoDebugService + the ASM NoDebugClassFileTransformer E2E (S6B-B). Never cite this directory as proof that the packaged class has no LocalVariableTable (only javap -l can prove that) nor as proof of async/loop folding/L2 overhead. The chain models the endpoint-only call (no frontend root in the default demo UI), so the controller is a legal isolated backend root (LOST + LOST_BACKEND).

runtimeProbeExpectations.build: NoDebugService.java is compiled normally, then maven-antrun-plugin 3.1.0 recompiles ONLY that class in process-classes with javac debug="false" (includeantruntime=false, fork=true, executable=${java.home}/bin/javac, classpath=maven.compile.classpath) and overwrites target/classes
runtimeProbeExpectations.javapPrecheck: javap -l -p -classpath target/classes com.example.shop.service.NoDebugService must show NO LocalVariableTable and NO LineNumberTable; L2DemoService must still show local:D; the packaged boot jar class must be re-extracted and re-checked
runtimeProbeExpectations.transformer: NoDebugClassFileTransformer (ASM, exact class com.example.shop.service.NoDebugService, method compute(D)D) injects enter/exit only, never a line probe; class/method/descriptor/single-DRETURN mismatches are fail-open counters
runtimeProbeExpectations.lvtPresentGate: if the class still carries a LocalVariableTable the transformer logs nodebug_lvt_present, returns the original bytes and does not instrument; S6B-B must FAIL (never instrument as plain L2, never guess names/lines)
runtimeProbeExpectations.noValues: the values key is omitted entirely (never [] and never a placeholder/guessed local)

chain.flagsRuntimeAssertion: runtime flags may append advisory flags (DROP_COUNT=<n>, ASYNC_INHERITED only if the call were on a different thread); assert includes('NO_DEBUG_INFO') and absence of L1 / L2 / ASYNC_INHERITED / VALUES_CAPPED / VALUES_TOTAL on this same-thread span; never deep-equal arrays

facts.summary: 无 LVT 的方法不是 OK/成功：事件状态固定 NOT_COLLECTED_NO_DEBUG_INFO（灰虚线，不猜变量名）
reason 逐字 LocalVariableTable missing（非空；说明为什么采不到）
恰 1 个 span 带 NO_DEBUG_INFO flag（service），controller 不带
values 键缺失（不是 []、不是占位值、不出现 kind=local/param/field/return）
return 是真实方法返回值 200（amount*2），不编造
无调试信息不得伪造行号：source 缺失或 line=null（-g:none 也去掉了 SourceFile）
endpoint-only 链没有前端根：controller 是合法游离后端根（LOST），子 span 继承 LOST；status/confidence 正交
同线程调用不带 ASYNC_INHERITED（无伪造异步）
没有变量名/行号猜测：无局部变量项、无 source.line、无行号探针

requests.statusRule: existing aggregate priority (THREW > UNKNOWN > NOT_COLLECTED_POLICY > NOT_COLLECTED_LOST > NOT_COLLECTED_NO_DEBUG_INFO > TRUNCATED > RETURNED_FALSE > OK); the no-debug service makes the trace NOT_COLLECTED_NO_DEBUG_INFO
requests.scriptedVariantNote: a header-joined run (traceparent + X-TraceBoard-Click) has the same 2 backend spans with controller confidence EXACT (parent = fetch spanId, no LOST_BACKEND); that is runtime-only, not this fixture

graph.sortRule: nodes: startNs ascending, ties by spanId; edges: parent node order then child node order

workbenchExpectations.noDebugTone: notcollected (grey dashed; NOT a success/OK tone)
workbenchExpectations.noDebugRule: node.status === 'NOT_COLLECTED_NO_DEBUG_INFO' only; reason text comes from the event reason (graph node reason), never a hard-coded guess
workbenchExpectations.valuesEmptyText: 未采集（该节点无 values；S5 只采参数/字段写入/返回摘要）
workbenchExpectations.bannerText: S6：L2 行级（reconcileAmount）、异步继承（reconcileAsync）、无调试信息（NoDebugService#compute，NOT_COLLECTED_NO_DEBUG_INFO）、循环折叠（reconcileLoop）；长生命周期线程池不自动传播；行级字段写入/对象深采/多方法 L2 未支持
workbenchExpectations.noDebugNoteText: S6 无调试信息：NoDebugService#compute 无 LocalVariableTable，状态 NOT_COLLECTED_NO_DEBUG_INFO；不猜变量名/行号
staleTextsMustBeAbsentFromSrcAndDist: S6a：仅 L2DemoService#reconcileAmount 采集行级局部变量（L2）与逐次 ×3；其他方法无 L2；异步/无调试信息/循环折叠/开销属 S6b
异步/无调试信息/循环折叠/开销属 S6b
negativeAssertions: no L2 badge/note on the no-debug node
no async badge on the same-thread no-debug span
no fold note on a span without VALUES_CAPPED/VALUES_TOTAL
the no-debug node is never rendered with the success/OK tone
workbenchExpectations.sourceTextIsIndicative: controller source line is shape only; the no-debug service has no line at all
